title: aad-construction — case shape (v0.1)
description: Per-call-site AAD framing decomposition for every pub aad_* builder in protocol/src/aead.rs. Pins the full AAD bytes (as ctx-aead does) PLUS the structural segment breakdown — aad_prefix ('myne.v0.1|') / protocol_version / u16-be length prefix / role_label / bound parameters — with byte offsets. Complements ctx-aead's aad_canonical_bytes cases (which pin only the total bytes): a port that emits the right total but assembles it from the wrong pieces (forgets the u16 length-prefix, wrong field order) is caught here. One case per builder. Spec contract: docs/spec/protocol.md §5.2.

vector_id.description: Stable identifier of the form 'aad-construction/v0.1/<builder-name>'. Immutable once shipped.

input_builder_name.description: Which pub aad_* builder this case pins. The harness dispatches on this value, supplying the builder's specific inputs from the input_* fields below.

input_kdf_params.description: Present for aad_password_wrap / aad_recovery_wrap (the wrap AADs bind the canonical kdf_params block).

expected_aad_hex.description: The full AAD bytes the builder produces (hex). Identical to the bytes ctx-aead's aad_canonical_bytes case pins for the same builder.

informational_aad_segments.description: Ordered structural decomposition of expected_aad_hex. The segments' bytes concatenate to expected_aad_hex; offsets are contiguous from 0; each length equals its bytes_hex byte count. This is the per-call-site framing layer ctx-aead does not pin.

offset.description: Byte offset of this segment within the full AAD.

length.description: Byte length of this segment; equals bytes_hex.length / 2.
